biography.plain_text: Mauro Sipsz is an Italian businessman based in Monaco who built car dealerships and co-founded Nordauto and N.Technology, developing and running competition cars for Fiat-group brands. A rally driver as well as a team principal, he later established Acceleration with Monica Bregoli, providing motorsport consultancy and trading specialist cars.

long_biography.plain_text:
At N.Technology, Italian entrepreneur Mauro Sipsz combined racing programmes with the business of building cars for other competitors. He and his team examined costs, feasibility and commercial prospects before developing the Fiat Grande Punto S2000 for a new, less expensive rally category. They also produced competition versions for Fiat's Turkish and Portuguese operations.

Sipsz divided his working week between technical and commercial management, then spent weekends at events that sometimes overlapped. He relocated to Chivasso to work near the main engineering operation, while specialist colleagues took responsibility for technical development and sporting management. Customer programmes included race support and in-house vehicle development, with Paolo Andreucci serving as a test driver.
